body:
# Shrinking Border & Rising Lava

Survive as long as possible while the world border shrinks and lava continuously rises beneath you.

Challenge your friends in a unique survival experience where every second counts. Explore, gather resources, and climb higher before the lava catches up.

## Features

- Rising lava system
- Configurable lava start height
- Shrinking world border
- Multiplayer support
- Biome-based world generation
- Quick world and round resets

## Commands

**/start**

Starts a new game. Configure the lava starting Y-level and begin the challenge.

**/newround**

Resets the current game area and starts a fresh round.

**/newworld**

Generate a new world and choose the biome you want to play in.

**/stopgame**

Stops the current game and prevents new lava from being placed.

## Goal

Stay alive for as long as possible while the border shrinks and the lava rises. The last surviving player wins.
